keycols=[21,26,31,36,41]
def read_state():
    L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[42]

def done_check():
    r=last_action_result
    return (r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('game_over'))
print('state before',read_state())

for k in [2,4,5]:

    if done_check(): print('COMPLETED seqA'); break
if not done_check():
    # Sequence B: press dark marker keys 1,3 in order
    for k in [1,3]:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':keycols[k-1]}])
        print('seqB press',k,'state',read_state(),'done',done_check())
        if done_check(): print('COMPLETED seqB'); break
